exuz: Harakatning ikki tomonini ajratuvchi ikkita sariq parallel chiziq bor.

def: Sodir bo'layotganda ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.
ex: I thought the lights were a strange phenomenon, but they were just shooting stars.
exuz: Men chiroqlarni g'alati hodisa deb o'yladim, lekin ular shunchaki uchar yulduzlar edi.

def: Havo, suv yoki yerni iflos qilish.

exuz: Beparvo zavod daryoni kimyoviy moddalar bilan ifloslantirdi.

ex: The other students ridicule Peter's foreign accent.
exuz: Boshqa o'quvchilar Piterning chet el aksentini masxara qiladi.

ex: Using solar energy is good for the environment.
exuz: Quyosh energiyasidan foydalanish atrof-muhit uchun yaxshi.

def: Mamlakatga tegishli, lekin shtat bo'lmagan yer bo'lagi.
ex: Gibraltar is a territory of Great Britain.
exuz: Gibraltar Buyuk Britaniyaning hududi.

ex: My dad is playing in a golf tournament tomorrow.
exuz: Dadam ertaga golf turnirida o'ynaydi.

def: Odam yoki narsa tashiy oladigan har qanday transport turi.
ex: I don't have a car, so my normal transportation is the train.
exuz: Mening mashinam yo'q, shuning uchun odatdagi transportim poyezd.

def: Tovar yoki xizmat uchun qarz bo'lgan pul haqida hujjat.
ex: I have so many bills that I do not know how to pay them all.
exuz: Menda shunchalik ko'p to'lov borki, hammasini qanday to'lashni bilmayman.

def: Bir yer maydoni tugab, boshqasi boshlanadigan chiziq.
ex: This fence shows the boundary between our yard and yours.
exuz: Bu to'siq bizning hovli bilan sizniki orasidagi chegarani ko'rsatadi.

ex: His presentation was in chaos. I couldn't understand what he meant.
exuz: Uning taqdimoti tartibsiz edi. Men u nima demoqchi ekanini tushunmadim.

def: Odam doim bir xil xulq yoki munosabatda bo'lsa.
ex: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.
exuz: Sara har kuni keladi va u bizning eng izchil xodimimiz.

def: Yomg'ir va shamol bilan doira bo'ylab aylanadigan katta bo'ron.
ex: Hundreds of homes were damaged by the cyclone.
exuz: Siklon yuzlab uylarga zarar yetkazdi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ladi yoki vayron bo'ladi.
ex: Since I spent all my money, my date with Jane is doomed.
exuz: Hamma pulimni sarflaganim uchun Jeyn bilan uchrashuvim barbod bo'lishga mahkum.

def: Vafot etgan odamning pul yoki mol-mulkini oladigan kishi.
ex: The princess was the heir to the king and queen's throne.
exuz: Malika shoh va malikaning taxt vorisi edi.

ex: Karate is a martial art that began many years ago in Japan.

ex: The organic carrots are more expensive, but they're better for you.

def: Go'sht va tuxum uchun ishlatiladigan tovuq kabi qush.

exuz: U parranda boqib, go'shtini qo'shimcha pul uchun sotadi.

ex: The hikers scrambled down the side of the hill.
exuz: Sayyohlar tepalikning yon bag'ridan shoshib tushishdi.

exuz: U armiyada bir yil xizmat qilgach, serjant darajasiga ko'tarildi.

ex: I was impressed by her sheer dedication to jogging.
exuz: Men uning yugurishga bo'lgan mutlaq sadoqatiga qoyil qoldim.

def: Odam biror masala haqida aniq aytgan munosabat.

exuz: Mening fikrim: neft va gazdan foydalanish atrof-muhit uchun yomon.

def: Sim orqali elektr xabarlarini yuborish usuli.
ex: In the 1900s, the telegraph was the fastest way to send a message.
exuz: 1900-yillarda telegraf xabar yuborishning eng tez yo'li edi.

ex: The blue textile was going to be used to make blouses.
exuz: Ko'k mato kofta tikish uchun ishlatilmoqchi edi.

def: Tez aylanadigan trubka shaklidagi havo hosilasi.
ex: During a tornado, the safest place to be is underground.
exuz: Tornado paytida eng xavfsiz joy — yer osti.

def: Doira bo'ylab harakatlanadigan katta tropik bo'ron.

exuz: Tayfun Avstraliyaga urilgach, minglab odam elektrsiz qoldi.
